undated_mentions: Started working on Italian TV in the 1950s (decade only)
Born in New York City; moved to Turin when he was young
During World War II joined a group of Italian partisans
Captured, spent seven months in San Vittore prison, deported to German camp, liberated via prisoner exchange
Appeared on first day of official public TV transmissions in Italy with Arrivi e partenze on RAI
Started hosting Genius on Rete 4 (only end date 2005 given)
Moved to Tele Milano (now Canale 5), owned by Mediaset
Brief return to RAI with Flash (no own date)
Continued working for Mediaset quiz programmes
Guest on Apocalypse Show on Rai 1
Body lay in repose at the Triennale in Milan before the funeral
Buried in family tomb at Dagnente Cemetery near Arona
Married to wife Daniela Zuccoli (no wedding date)
